description: Fresh self-authored physics and chemistry word problems (kinematics, density, Ohm's law, unit conversions, molarity, stoichiometry, force/work/power/pressure). This first rung-4 PR keeps every gold decomposition a plain ASCII arithmetic formula whose numbers all appear in the stem, so today's exact-compute engine verifies the option-selection mechanism at 100%. The unit symbols (km/h, g/cm^3, mol/L, N, J, W, Pa) live in the prose; carrying dimensions through the engine as first-class typed quantities is the next rung-4 PR (dimensional engine, see ADJ-LADDER.md §5). Conversion factors are stated in the stem (e.g. '1 minute equals 60 seconds') so the formula never smuggles a hidden constant past the no-result-literals gate.

items.stem: A car travels 240 km in 3 hours. What is its average speed in km/h?
A cyclist rides at a steady 12 m/s for 15 s. How many meters does she travel?
A runner covers 100 m at a steady 5 m/s. How many seconds does the run take?
A metal block has a mass of 96 g and a volume of 12 cm^3. What is its density in g/cm^3?
A liquid has a density of 2 g/mL and a volume of 25 mL. What is its mass in g?
A resistor of 8 ohms carries a current of 3 A. Using V = I times R, what is the voltage in volts?
A 12 V battery is connected across a resistance of 4 ohms. Using I = V divided by R, what is the current in amperes?
A device draws a current of 2 A when connected to 18 V. Using R = V divided by I, what is its resistance in ohms?
How many seconds are in 7 minutes, given that 1 minute equals 60 seconds?
A road is 3 km long. Given that 1 km equals 1000 m, how many meters long is the road?
A bag of sand has a mass of 4 kg. Given that 1 kg equals 1000 g, what is its mass in grams?
A film runs for 2 hours. Given that 1 hour equals 60 minutes, how many minutes long is the film?
A solution contains 6 mol of solute dissolved to make 2 L of solution. What is the molarity in mol/L?
A solution has a concentration of 5 mol/L and a volume of 4 L. How many moles of solute does it contain?
A chemist has 88 g of a compound whose molar mass is 44 g/mol. How many moles is that?
How many grams are in 3 mol of a compound whose molar mass is 18 g/mol?
A 7 kg cart accelerates at 4 m/s^2. Using F = m times a, what is the net force in newtons?
A constant force of 20 N pushes a crate 5 m in the direction of the force. Using W = F times d, how much work is done in joules?
An engine does 600 J of work in 30 s. Using P = W divided by t, what is the power in watts?
A force of 50 N is spread evenly over an area of 10 m^2. Using P = F divided by A, what is the pressure in pascals?
